scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
scripts.lint: uvx ruff@0.17.4 check . && uvx ruff@0.17.4 format --check . && npx --yes prettier@3.10.0 --check . && uvx --from shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 shellcheck plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh && uvx --from shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -d -i 2 plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh
scripts.format: uvx ruff@0.17.4 format . && npx --yes prettier@3.10.0 --write . && uvx --from shfmt-py==4.2.0 shfmt -w -i 2 plugin/hooks/*.sh plugin/scripts/*.sh
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin validate --strict plugin
